svg.title: SevaForge v3.0 — Cloud-Deployed Architecture (AWS)
svg.text: LAYER 4 — Pipeline Agents (EKS Fargate Pods — HPA Autoscaled)
LAYER 6 — External AI Providers (via Bedrock Model Access)
CLI/API → ALB → WAF + Cognito → EKS Fargate (MissionControl) → Agent Pods → Bedrock → Aurora/S3 → Response
SQS async pipeline • Aurora pgvector for RAG • IRSA (no static credentials) • WAF + Shield DDoS protection
Fargate serverless pods • HPA per agent type • SQS handles backpressure • ElastiCache caches LLM responses
